$comment: Schema for the shell chrome's refresh_page action. Self-contained and closed: re-declares every property action.v1 would otherwise provide and rejects any undeclared field, on itself and on its own payload.

type.$comment: Self-reference to this action's schema type ID

target.$comment: The screen domain, whose implementation (mfe/screenDomain.ts) registers the handler, so a chain aimed at the popup, sidebar or overlay domain is refused here instead of two layers later as a missing handler

payload.$comment: Closed and empty: the reload takes no payload. Whatever failed, the answer is the same page reloaded, so the requests that failed run again
